launch_gate: Do not submit before the independent RepeatModeler full-panel audit verifies one completed classified library for each of the 526 manifest taxa.
scope: All manifest taxa remain eligible. The per-taxon library combines its completed RepeatModeler 2.0.9 classified consensus with Dfam 4.0 fungi/ancestor curated consensus. Output is repeat-instance evidence, not evidence of rearrangement, causality, or protein structural change.
